title: Lighting randomization (randomize_lighting)
desc: Per-episode perturbation of every light around its authored value: position ±0.5 m, direction ±1 rad, ambient/diffuse/specular ±0.1, random on/off (at least one light is forced back on). Same seed-5 layout in every tile; only the lighting is re-rolled. Off by default for PiPER-X cubes-in-cup — flipped on here.
metrics: 2 lights · 7 rolls: 1-2 lights on · diffuse mean 0.38-0.79 · max direction tilt 48° (cap 57°)
